frozen: Written and committed before any run. Run once per arm; not edited after it has been run. Its first result stands as reported.
purpose: Portability: the same facts in a warehouse laid out differently (layout B, built by clinical_core/agere/tiered/portability.py). Arms: Agere on the original semantic layer (control); Agere on layout B through the engineer-written mapping (config/agere/mappings/layout_b.reviewed.json); Agere on layout B through a mapping a frontier model drafted unedited; a frontier model alone writing its own SQL over layout B.
held_out: Not used by the learning loop, the curriculum or as recipe examples. Most question shapes resemble earlier proof sets on the original layout: the test is whether what Agere knows carries to another layout, not whether it knows new questions. The stack is scored on a copy of its saved recipes with learning switched off.
reference: Computed in clinical_core/agere/tiered/proof.py on the original semantic layer (AGERE_PROOF_REFERENCE_DB), without the stack's SQL, recipes or mapping. Where a question returns labelled rows (numbers_only), only the numbers are compared, because a warehouse may rightly label rows with its own codes.
phrasing: Two phrasings per question. Both are meant to have one reading; the second states the rule. For the two care-gap questions the first phrasing relies on a governed definition.
scoring: +1 right, 0 declined, -10 wrong. An unanswerable question that is answered counts as wrong. Two phrasings per question, two runs each, all runs reported.
known_differences: Layout B holds no documents, visits, encounters, claim denials or enrollment spans. The mapped latest-value table derives vitals differently from the original (labs agree); no question uses latest vitals.
